target: the exact R6M unit-objective static cost C, with objective_index retained explicitly so QG-2/QG-8 scope is not erased
theorem_targets: T1: an exact predictor measurable only with respect to Psi exists iff C is constant on every Psi fibre

T2: on a finite mixed fibre, every point prediction constant on the fibre has worst-case absolute error at least half the cost range; midpoint achieves that minimax bound when unrestricted real outputs are allowed
T3: no increase in expression size, search depth, or formula grammar over unchanged Psi can repair a mixed-cost fibre
T4: adding a primitive q can repair exactness only by separating every opposite-cost pair that was Psi-indistinguishable
fresh_test_requirement: Before reading exact costs in a fresh size/family sector, freeze its instance IDs and either (a) predict that the existing Psi has a mixed fibre and name a witness-search criterion, or (b) freeze one mechanism-derived new primitive q and its predicted separating pairs. No primitive may be added after fresh costs are opened under this identity.
optional_practical_bridge: Only after theorem terminal is fixed: compare certificate/search effort against pinned Qiskit/tket resource-estimation or compiler baselines; native heuristic output is not theorem gold.
